investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocks All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-23T00:27:19–53Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production API's POST /api/agents call could not reach the swarm gateway ELB at the /v1/agents endpoint. Because the failure is shared across every sibling check with the exact same error message, the fault is localized to the swarm gateway layer, not to any individual eval or check-specific code path.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2) was unreachable from the production API at the time of the eval run. Every attempt to POST to /v1/agents via the gateway returned a 502 bad_gateway, preventing agent provisioning from starting and causing all required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) to go uncollected. This is an eval-observed infrastructure connectivity failure localized to the swarm gateway dependency; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so impact to production end-users cannot be confirmed from this packet alone.

The snapshot file itself is reachable and structurally valid (all required evidence fields are present, source is "github-actions", hasLiveSource and hasNonUnknownFeatureData are both true), but its embedded generation timestamp is too old to satisfy the contract assertion `snapshotAgeMinutes max: 300` defined in infra/evals/status/check-expectations.json line 482.
